name: Lucky Chinese Food
notes: Site's own elcajon.html is an Adobe Animate/CreateJS canvas animation with no text menu (dead end). DoorDash schema.org Menu JSON-LD read instead; address 1571 N Magnolia Ave, El Cajon matches. Raw JSON-LD had a Party Trays section short of the rendered MenuBookCategory count (25 of 34 items) -- catering trays are an adjunct and excluded entirely rather than filed partial. 'Most Ordered' carousel (12 items) dropped as a pure duplicate of items in the real categories (verified: zero unique items). All 8 remaining categories (House Specials, Appetizers, Soups, Family Special, Combination Plates, Dinner Entree, Small Sides, Large Sides) matched the rendered category-nav item counts exactly, so this is complete for the core menu. Divisor sweep (1.00-1.35) found no multiplier landing more than 1/54 prices on round dollars, and dish-variant price steps are consistent ($2.00 protein upcharge, $2.50 combo step), so the .79-ending prices read as DoorDash's actual listed prices, not a detected markup formula -- still capped at medium since it is a delivery marketplace, not the restaurant's own site.

name: Black Cat Bar
blocked: Open, address and review count (425) confirmed exact match via Google Maps at 4246 University Ave, San Diego, CA 92105. Its only web presence is a WordPress.com site (blackcatbar.wordpress.com) that is entirely a live-music/events calendar (About page, yearly calendar-archive pages back to 2014) with no menu page or any food/drink price content at all. Search turns up only third-party mentions: Yelp says 'Try Our New Menu' but the page is captcha/bot-walled; MapQuest and Mindtrip describe signature cocktails in prose with no prices; the one source with numeric prices (San Diego Reader, 2011) is 15 years stale ('cocktails and drafts $3.50+') and pre-dates any 'new menu'. No DoorDash/order.online/other delivery-platform listing found for this bar. No current, extractable per-item price list exists anywhere reachable.
notes: Bar with live music/pool tables; a taco cart was mentioned in a 2011 review as weekend-only food, status today unknown. Marking blocked rather than not_found since the business is confirmed open.
